note: Free engines on the studio Mac's ComfyUI server (providers/comfyui.py), offered to Dossier visual-model selections beside the paid providers. Kept out of prompt_modules.v1.json so its bytes, and every recipe pinned to them, stay unchanged. These entries add engine options only: formats, families and prompts are untouched. billing: local means no budget reservation or debit, matching generation_budget.is_local_provider.

local-h3.note: MiniMax H3 first/last-frame, always 16:9 (FORCE_LANDSCAPE), so a crop_mode family (truck, boat) still cuts five 9:16 crops. About 10 minutes per 6 s master on the studio Mac with the 8-step LoRA.

local-h3-vertical.note: The same H3 model rendered natively 9:16 (or in the start image's shape). About 6 minutes per 6 s clip.

local-wan-i2v.note: Wan 2.2 image-to-video 14B; the output keeps the start image's shape. 720p matches wan-i2v-fast; 480p renders in about 2-3 minutes, 720p takes longer.
